headline: Janus Henderson and Centrifuge Launch Onchain Nasdaq-100 Fund on Stellar
summary: $500 billion asset manager Janus Henderson and Centrifuge have launched an issuer-sponsored tokenized Nasdaq-100 fund on the Stellar blockchain.
why: Tokenized traditional financial assets bridge decentralized finance protocols with established public market securities, expanding retail and institutional access to equity indices.

impacts.name: Stellar
impacts.why: Deployment of a major institutional tokenized equity fund expands blockchain utility.
